title: Mother Holding Newborn Baby Outdoors, 1963 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black and white outdoor snapshot from August 1963 depicting a mother lovingly holding her sleeping newborn baby. She is wearing a light-colored sleeveless collared shirt in a suburban neighborhood with tree shade, tiled-roof houses, and a vintage parked automobile visible behind her. The edge of the print bears the date code stamp AUG 63 J.
